Mayar Sherif Ahmed Abdel-Aziz ( Arabic : ميار شريف أحمد عبد العزيز ; born 5 May 1996) is an Egyptian professional tennis player. She has a career-high WTA ranking of No. 31 in singles, making her the highest ranked Egyptian singles player, male or female, in the Open Era . [ 2 ] She also has a career-high of No. 65 in doubles. 
Sherif has won one singles title on the WTA Tour and two titles in doubles. She has also won a record eight WTA 125 singles titles and two doubles titles on the WTA Challenger Tour along with eleven singles and six doubles titles on the ITF Circuit .
